title: E-commerce Manager
description:
The **E\-commerce Manager** will oversee the end\-to\-end digital commerce ecosystem. This includes managing our standalone website, expanding onto major fashion marketplaces, driving digital marketing strategy, and streamlining fulfillment operations. The ideal candidate blends creative fashion intuition with data\-driven operational discipline. **What You’ll Be Doing****Online Store Management (D2C)*** **Website UX:** Optimize site navigation, product pages, and checkout flows to maximize conversion rates.
* **Catalog Management:** Oversee timely product uploads, accurate descriptions, inventory syncing, and seasonal collections.
* **Tech Oversight:** Manage the backend platform (e.g., Shopify, Magento, or WooCommerce) and integrate necessary plugins with help of developers.

**Marketplace Management*** **Channel Expansion:** Launch, manage, and scale Niomi Couture on major fashion marketplaces (e.g., Amazon, Myntra, Nykaa, or regional platforms).
* **Listing Optimization:** Ensure high\-quality imagery, SEO\-friendly titles, and competitive pricing structures across platforms.
* **Account Health:** Monitor seller ratings, compliance metrics, and buy\-box ownership.

**Digital Marketing \& Growth*** **Campaign Strategy:** Plan and execute performance marketing strategies including Meta Ads, Google PPC, and Retargeting.
* **Retention Marketing:** Drive customer loyalty and repeat purchases via Email and SMS marketing automation.
* **SEO \& Content:** Coordinate with creative teams to optimize keywords and produce high\-converting landing pages.
* **Analytics:** Track daily traffic, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).

**Operations \& Logistics*** **Inventory Control:** Partner with the production team to prevent stockouts and manage overstock situations.
* **Order Fulfillment:** Coordinate with warehouse teams and logistics partners to ensure fast, damage\-free shipping.
* **Customer Experience:** Supervise the customer support workflow to quickly resolve returns, exchanges, and payment issues.

**Reporting and Management*** **Reporting:** Prepare monthly MIS and present various data points to brand owners and help them with insights.
* **Planning:** Based on reports, make quarterly plans and execute and report every month.
* **Team:** Hire and manage a lean team to run business and manage team performance.

 **What We’d Love To See*** **3–5 years of experience** in e\-commerce management, preferably within **fashion, luxury, lifestyle, B2C, or D2C brands**.
* Proven experience managing both **D2C websites and online marketplaces**.
* Hands\-on understanding of e\-commerce platforms such as **Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce**, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of **performance marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads/PPC, retargeting, SEO, email/SMS marketing, and web analytics**.
* Experience working with **marketplace seller panels** and managing marketplace performance.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with good command of **MS Excel/Google Sheets**.
* Ability to analyze business data, identify trends, prepare forecasts, and make **data\-driven decisions**.
* Strong ownership and execution skills with the ability to manage multiple aspects of an e\-commerce business.

 **It’d Be Great If You Had*** Experience scaling an **online fashion, luxury, lifestyle, or premium consumer brand**.
* Experience managing **end\-to\-end e\-commerce P\&L/revenue growth** or significant ownership of business targets.
* Experience with **CRM and marketing automation tools** for customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
* Understanding of **e\-commerce analytics, conversion optimization, customer journey, and merchandising**.
* Experience building and managing a **small, high\-performing e\-commerce team**.
* A hands\-on, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to **spot opportunities, solve problems, and turn insights into action**.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**WE'RE HIRING – BRAND MANAGER**  
Join The Adbook India Private Limited

**Build Brands. Create Impact. Drive Growth.**

At **The Adbook India Private Limited**, we're redefining Digital Out\-of\-Home (DOOH) advertising with innovative digital media solutions across residential communities, commercial buildings, healthcare, retail, and transit environments.

We're looking for a passionate, creative, and strategic **Brand Manager** to strengthen our brand presence, drive marketing initiatives, and support our rapid growth across India.

Position: **Brand Manager**

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute brand strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across all marketing channels.
* Plan and execute digital, social media, and offline marketing campaigns.
* Create compelling marketing content, presentations, and promotional materials.
* Coordinate product launches, events, PR activities, and brand partnerships.
* Manage agency relationships, creative vendors, and marketing budgets.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and consumer insights.
* Collaborate with Sales, Business Development, and Product teams to support lead generation and customer engagement.
* Monitor campaign performance and recommend data\-driven improvements.
* Ensure brand consistency across websites, social media, advertisements, and customer communications.

Preferred Skills

* Strong branding and storytelling skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
* Creative thinking with an eye for design and detail.
* Experience in digital marketing and social media management.
* Knowledge of Meta Ads, LinkedIn, Google Ads, SEO, and content marketing.
* Strong project management and multitasking abilities.
* Analytical mindset with experience using marketing analytics tools.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in Brand Management, Marketing, Advertising, or Digital Media.
* Experience in the Advertising, Media, DOOH, or Technology industry is preferred.

Pay: ₹17,622\.05 \- ₹65,547\.62 per month

Work Location: In person

title: DSA Manager
description:
### **Job Summary:**


The DSA Manager (Direct Sales Agent Manager) will be responsible for leading, motivating, and managing a team of Direct Sales Agents to achieve ambitious sales targets for various financial products. This role involves comprehensive oversight of the sales cycle, from recruitment and training of agents to performance management, strategic planning, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a proven track record in sales management, and deep knowledge of financial products.


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop and implement effective sales strategies and plans to achieve and exceed sales targets for the DSA team.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and continuously develop a high\-performing team of Direct Sales Agents.
* Provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback to team members to enhance their sales capabilities and productivity.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance against targets, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and set clear objectives for individual team members.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify new sales opportunities and adjust strategies accordingly.
* Ensure strict adherence to all company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements related to sales activities.
* Manage customer relationships and resolve complex customer issues escalated by the sales team.
* Prepare and present regular sales reports, forecasts, and performance analyses to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as marketing and product development, to optimize sales efforts and product offerings.
* Motivate the sales team through incentives, recognition programs, and a positive work environment.
